title: Roman Roman Roman
style: Electronica reggae with dembow-leaning offbeats, crisp drum-machine skank, and trumpet lead riffs; verse rides sparse bass, clipped guitar chops, and a chant bed, pre-chorus opens with rising keys and crowd shouts, chorus hits with big band brass stabs and unison name chants. Lead vocal is dry and close in verses, doubled and call-and-response on hooks, with short delay throws on the name. Ear candy: reverse cymbal swells into each chorus, trumpet flares between lines, tape-stop flicks before the final drop. Bright, punchy, and wide., electronica, big band
